recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR core source change is needed unless datatype table generation later stops using source/datatypes/primitives.xml.
issue_request: FHIR-37406 asked to change the code datatype regex display to [^\s]+( [^\s]+)* because the old \s occurrence allowed tabs, carriage returns, line feeds, and other whitespace contrary to the datatype prose.
initial_application: Git commit 92efc0e06b73601ad153b28144664fd95a3aa741 changed source/datatypes.html from [^\s]+(\s[^\s]+)* to [^\s]+( [^\s]+)*. The earlier FHIR-25413 commit c4807a5165ee632872ef9f6289fee8e9e1abbb5f had already corrected source/datatypes/primitives.xml.
additional_context: Current source/datatypes.html no longer carries a literal regex for code; it uses [%regex code%], while source/datatypes/primitives.xml carries the authoritative corrected regex. FHIR-6181 is older background, but the R5-relevant stale display was resolved by the FHIR-25413/FHIR-37406 sequence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the authoritative primitive pattern is corrected, the datatype page points to the generated regex placeholder, and no old code regex occurrences remain in current source.
